decisions.reason: The mobile-phone presentation changes the hero visual treatment but does not alter the established hero headline or explanatory copy.
The source adds a specific presentation constraint to the hero product image without changing the approved clean, minimal SaaS design style.
Displaying the hero photo recognizably on a mobile phone does not require or change animation behavior.
The source changes the treatment of an existing hero image, not the landing page's content mix, specification source, screenshot selection, or scope.
The source explicitly concerns the top hero photo and does not change the separate bottom-of-page image.
